name: Shenzhen H&T Intelligent Control Co.Ltd
summary: Shenzhen H&T Intelligent Control Co.Ltd, together with its subsidiaries, researches and develops, manufactures, sells, and markets intelligent controller products in China and internationally. It offers household appliances which includes washing machine, oven, dryer, air conditioner, air fryer, vacuum cleaner, dishwasher, stove, refrigerator, and air purifier control boards; and power tools comprise lawn mower and slotting machine control boards, battery management systems, tool lamps, and chargers.
